Homonyms: Elektronika already in the index under A5 (Soviet watches, same state brand umbrella) -> add E5 dept; Asetek is in D1 (liquid cooling), its SimSports sim-racing line is unsourced here; Codemasters is in E5 only through Game Genie (mainly software). Victrix, Cube, Grid, PXN, Ramar, Electrolab, Zaccaria have no clashing index rows. Thin areas retried: Virpil (added, premium), Nacon (added), Tectoy (re-sourced), Playdate/Panic and Heusinkveld (already in index), home arcade (Raw Thrills added), music/dance (Andamiro added; CRKD only own shop), modding (Hand Held Legend, eXtremeRate, existence), Brook/Ultimarc/Scuf/CH Products/Elaut/Trak Racer/Asetek: only own or shop/investor pages found -> not added.
